absent: Locking discipline for thread_info, TLB gather state and batch state is not shown.
Lifecycle and allocation rules for page-table descriptors and address spaces are not shown.
Semantics of broadcast versus local TLBI scope and barrier ordering beyond the named wrappers are not shown.
Guarded-stack, PIE, POE and GICv5 hardware state machines beyond field layouts are not shown.

findings.text: Hypervisor list register packs virtual identifier in low 32 bits, physical identifier in a ten bit field starting at bit 32, priority in an eight bit field starting at bit 48, end of interrupt at bit 41, group at bit 60, hardware flag at bit 61, and a two bit lifecycle state at the top where one bit means pending and the other means active.

Indirection permission model uses four bit slots per index. Overlay values are none zero, read one, execute two, read plus execute three, read plus write five, read plus write without execute six, full seven. Base values are read eight, guarded stack nine, read plus execute ten, read plus write twelve, full fourteen. Slot offset is index times four and preparation masks to four bits before shifting.

Overlay permission model uses four bit slots per index with none zero, read one, execute two, read plus execute three, write four, read plus write five, write plus execute six, full seven, masked to low four bits. Slot offset is index times four and preparation masks then shifts into place.

Guarded stack capability separates a 52 bit address occupying bits 63 to 12 from a 12 bit token occupying bits 11 to 0, each with shift, width, mask and extractor. Valid token is one and in-progress token is five. Construction preserves the address portion and sets the valid token value.

Eleven interrupt controller operations map to fixed system encodings distinguished in low fields: affinity 1-0-12-1-3, deactivate 1-0-12-2-0, deactivate with status 1-0-12-1-0, hardware management 1-0-12-2-1, enable 1-0-12-1-1, end of interrupt 1-0-12-1-7, pending 1-0-12-1-4, priority 1-0-12-1-2, config 1-0-12-1-5, acknowledge 1-0-12-3-0, non-maskable acknowledge 1-0-12-3-1. Generic helpers read redistributor forms and write distributer forms by operation suffix.

First group of distributer operand layouts shares a three bit type at bits 31 to 29 and a 24 bit identifier at bits 23 to 0. Affinity adds affinity value at bits 47 to 32 plus a routing-mode bit at 28. Deactivate-with-status provides extractors for its type and identifier. Hardware control adds a single management bit at 32.

Second group keeps the same type and identifier placement. Pending state and both acknowledge forms each add a single validity or state bit at 32 with extractors for acknowledge validity. Priority adds a five bit field at bits 39 to 35. Configuration uses only type and identifier.

Per-task low level state starts with flags, optionally saved user page-table base when software PAN is enabled, then a union aliasing a 64 bit preemption counter with separate count and reschedule-needed words whose order swaps by endianness, optionally shadow-stack base and pointer, optionally memory partitioning identifier, and finally current CPU number.

Thread flag positions run zero signal pending, one reschedule, two lazy reschedule, three resume notification, four foreign floating state, five uprobe, six async tag fault, seven signal notification, eight trace, nine audit, ten tracepoint, eleven seccomp, twelve emulation, thirteen pending patch, eighteen out-of-memory death, nineteen freeze, twenty restore mask, twenty-one single step, twenty-two 32-bit mode, twenty-three vector extension, twenty-four vector length inherit, twenty-five speculation control, twenty-six tagged addresses, twenty-seven matrix extension, twenty-eight matrix length inherit, twenty-nine kernel floating state, thirty counter access fault, thirty-one lazy MMU pending. Single-bit masks shift one by the position; syscall work groups trace, audit, tracepoint, seccomp and emulation.

Initial task state marks floating state as foreign and uses the generic initial preemption value. Shadow-stack initialization is conditional: when enabled both base and current pointer start at the initial shadow stack, otherwise it contributes nothing.

Small accessors expose the saved stack pointer from task CPU context, alias the new-execution setup hook to the architecture handler, and define the cycle counter read as the architected timer counter.
Each included header is idempotent through its own guard macro, and the generic TLB flush name is explicitly marked as architecture-provided.

Gather level inference returns unknown whenever tables were freed or mixed page-table levels were cleared; otherwise it maps exclusive clears at page, middle, upper and top levels to depths three down to zero. Range flushing skips walk-cache-only optimization when tables changed, handles whole-address-space teardown by flushing only if tables were freed, and otherwise invalidates the gathered interval with computed stride, level and flags.
Deferred page-table freeing converts each level pointer to its descriptor and queues it with the gather batch. Upper-level helpers are no-ops when that page-table level is disabled at runtime.
Unmap batch state carries no members because hardware performs TLB shootdown without a software CPU mask for IPIs.

Translation granule tags are one for 4K, two for 16K, three for 64K and zero otherwise. Single-entry TTL occupies bits 47 to 44 with unknown represented by the maximum integer. Range operand packs address bits from 36 to 0, TTL at 38 to 37, count at 43 to 39, scale at 45 to 44, granule at 47 to 46 and address-space identifier at 63 to 48. Maximum range size and count derive from count and scale parameters, and maximum distributed-virt-memory operations equal entries per page table page.

Low level invalidate emitters cover operand-less and register-operand TLBI forms selected by arity. Named single and range operations wrap those emitters, duplicating user-space variants where required, while level and range helpers insert granule-aware TTL and packed range arguments. The range walker prefers hardware range invalidates and degrades to single invalidates for unsupported hardware, single pages or misaligned start under large addresses, also covering stage-two ranges with current LPA2 state.

Synchronization helpers order a barrier before repeated synchronizing invalidates, adding an SME synchronization step for batch context when the corresponding workaround is active. elsewhere the SME step is an empty stub. Batch handling always defers and its explicit flush performs the batch synchronization sequence.
TLB flush modifiers form a bitwise type where none is zero, skip-walk-cache is bit zero, skip-sync is bit one, skip-notify is bit two and skip-broadcast is bit three.

Public range flushing uses unknown level because table entries may change alongside leaves, while single-page flushing uses default modifiers. Kernel page-table flushing orders barriers around a global invalidate plus synchronization. Pending batch adds use leaf depth with walk-cache and sync suppression. Entry-change tracking treats invalid-to-valid transitions and software-bit-only differences as needing no invalidate for both page and huge-page entries.
